headerDisplay: Homebridge plugin for the Nefit Easy™ (aka Worcester Wave™, Junkers Control™) thermostat.
footerDisplay: The serial number, access key and password are the same credentials you use in the Nefit Easy app.

serialNumber.title: Serial Number
serialNumber.description: The serial number of your Nefit Easy thermostat.

accessKey.title: Access Key
accessKey.description: The access key of your Nefit Easy thermostat.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password you set in the Nefit Easy app.

showOutdoorTemperature.title: Show outdoor temperature
showOutdoorTemperature.description: Adds a separate temperature sensor for the outdoor temperature measured by the thermostat.

pollingInterval.title: Polling interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often the backend is polled. Values below 30 seconds are raised to 30.
